subject: Concession approval: Orion custom per-token band + interim guardrail
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@orionai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@orionai.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 20:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing conversation follow-up / usage bands

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Orion is ready to move from the pilot to a hosted production contract, but we need clarity on a custom per-token band and a short-term guardrail while commitments ramp. We put together a two-quarter projection and a proposed custom band to share.

High level ask: 12-month commit, but with a stepped per-token rate that starts lower at initial volumes (to help with adoption) and then steps up once we hit sustained throughput. We also want a firm interim cap for the first 90 days so our CPO can sign off.

Attached: Orion_Usage_Projections_Q3-Q4.xlsx and a proposal PDF. Can you outline the internal path for approval and any documentation you need? We are on a tight board cadence and need final commercial terms by July 8.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships, OrionAI
--
OrionAI | sarah@orionai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@orionai.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@orionai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing conversation follow-up / usage bands

Sarah —

Appreciate the projection and clear timeline. We can support a stepped per-token band plus a 90-day interim cap, but a few internal approvals are required because this would deviate from our published rate card. I kicked this to Sales Ops and Revenue to confirm guardrails and minimums.

Can you confirm the following so we can fast-track:
- Targeted committed $/month for the first 3 months (so we can model cash flow and SLA exposure)
- Expected average tokens/month and peak 95th percentile tokens/month
- Any data residency or Private deployment constraints (I assume hosted in us-east)

If you can send a redline of the commercial term sheet (or confirm hot spots) and we get your signatures by June 28, we should be able to route an exception to pricing governance and aim for a July 6 internal approval.

I’ll loop in Hannah and Lauren on the next internal note.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0121
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orion custom band — what we need for pricing exception request

Folks — forwarding Orion's ask and Ben's note. Quick summary and suggested path:

Summary:
- Orion requests a stepped per-token band tied to committed spend (12 months) + a 90-day interim price cap
- Expected 3-month ramp: Q3 projected avg tokens month 1 = 1.8B, month 2 = 3.4B, month 3 = 5.2B (see spreadsheet)
- They want hosted US region; no private deployment requested now

What we need to submit a pricing exception to Governance: 
1) Deal economics worksheet (we need to run unit economics on the projected profile) — Ben, please attach the projection and a target committed ARR or monthly $ figure.
2) Risk mitigations for SLA and overage exposure (suggest: 90-day cap + step-up trigger tied to observed 7-day moving avg)
3) Suggested fallback rate bands if we hit sustained >6B tokens/mo for 2 sequential months
4) Proposed approval levels: Sales Manager (Ben) -> Sales Ops (Hannah) -> Revenue Ops (Lauren) -> CRO desk (Vivek) -> Pricing Governance Committee for exceptions > 30% off list

I can run the unit econ once the committed monthly $ is in the deal record. Also recommend we include a short clause in the SOW for audit-friendly logging and 45-day breach cure for sudden surge usage.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion custom band — what we need for pricing exception request

This looks reasonable. Quick notes from Revenue Ops:
- If Orion is committing to a 12-month term, we can structure a graduated slip: 0-2B tokens @ $0.0009/token, 2B-5B @ $0.00075/token, 5B+ @ $0.0006/token, with the 90-day cap set at a blended effective rate not to exceed $0.00085/token for that period. Those numbers are illustrative — need the committed $ to align mapping to ARR targets.
- If discount at peak band is >25% off published rate, it requires Pricing Governance review. Please flag the requested effective discount.
- Include a clause for quarterly reforecast and right to re-evaluate quantization/optimization credits if they adopt our caching/kv features.

I'll prepare a draft exception memo for the Governance committee once Ben drops the committed $ figure.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@orionai.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@orionai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing conversation follow-up / usage bands

Sarah —

Thanks for the projection. Per internal guidance we need a committed minimum of $250k/month for the first 3 months to justify the early lower banding; that gets the Revenue Ops numbers to target and keeps the Governance ask modest. If Orion can agree to $250k/month committed for months 1–3 (with the 90-day cap at blended effective rate <= $0.00085/token) we will: 
- Prepare an internal exception memo and route to Pricing Governance this week
- Produce a redlined term sheet reflecting the stepped band and the 90-day guardrail
- Provide an implementation note for SRE on rate limiting/monitoring and an audit log stub for compliance

If that works, can you confirm via reply and we’ll start the approval packet. We aim for an internal Governance decision by July 6 assuming signatures and the committed $ are in place.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Orion_Custom_Banding_Proposal.pdf (proposal), Orion_Usage_Projections_Q3-Q4.xlsx (projection)
